classification.difficultyReason: Select the appropriate similarity test from the givens and justify its conditions. The hardest angle cases link triangle angle sums or equal base angles to AAA; side cases require matching ratios and checking included angles or hypotenuses.

content.prompt:
Choose the similarity test that proves that these pairs of triangles are similar.
You must write the full reasoning.

spec.description: Paired triangles with an upright left triangle and an inverted right triangle; only the four supplied angles are shown.
spec.mathematics: Left angles include 60° and 75°; right angles include 45° and 75°.
spec.answerVisibility: Missing angles and similarity reasoning are answer-only.

answer.short: AAA: both triangles have angles $45^\circ$, $60^\circ$ and $75^\circ$, so corresponding angles are equal.
answer.worked:
The missing angle in the left triangle is
$$180^\circ-60^\circ-75^\circ=45^\circ.$$
The missing angle in the right triangle is
$$180^\circ-45^\circ-75^\circ=60^\circ.$$
At least two pairs of corresponding angles are equal, so the triangles are similar by AAA.

spec.description: Two right triangles in different orientations, with right-angle squares at the lower-left and upper-right vertices.
spec.answerVisibility: Only given lengths and right angles are visible.

answer.short: RHS: both triangles are right-angled and $\frac{18}{9}=\frac{8}{4}=2$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}\frac{18}{9}&=2\\\frac{8}{4}&=2\end{aligned}$$
Both triangles are right-angled. Their hypotenuses and another pair of corresponding sides are in the same ratio, so they are similar by RHS.

spec.description: Similarly oriented paired triangles with all six supplied side labels.
spec.mathematics: Corresponding sides are 3 and 4.5, 4 and 6, and 6 and 9.
spec.answerVisibility: Ratios and test names are answer-only.

answer.short: SSS: $\frac{4.5}{3}=\frac{6}{4}=\frac{9}{6}=1.5$, so all three pairs of corresponding sides are in the same ratio.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}\frac{4.5}{3}&=1.5\\\frac{6}{4}&=1.5\\\frac{9}{6}&=1.5\end{aligned}$$
Three pairs of corresponding sides are in the same ratio, so the triangles are similar by SSS.

spec.description: Upright narrow triangle beside an inverted triangle. A leader arrow identifies the left included 30° angle. The additional right-triangle 80° given is retained.
spec.mathematics: Sides meeting the left 30° angle are 3 and 5; sides meeting the right 30° angle are 9 and 15, respectively.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied sides, angles and the angle leader are visible.

answer.short: SAS: $\frac{9}{3}=\frac{15}{5}=3$ and the included angles are both $30^\circ$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}\frac{9}{3}&=3\\\frac{15}{5}&=3\end{aligned}$$
Two pairs of corresponding sides are in the same ratio and their included angles are both $30^\circ$, so the triangles are similar by SAS.

spec.description: Paired right triangles with right-angle squares at the upper vertex of the left figure and lower-right vertex of the right figure.
spec.answerVisibility: No derived lengths or ratios appear in the question diagram.

answer.short: RHS: both triangles are right-angled and $\frac{10}{5}=\frac{4}{2}=2$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}\frac{10}{5}&=2\\\frac{4}{2}&=2\end{aligned}$$
Both triangles are right-angled. Their hypotenuses and another pair of corresponding sides are in the same ratio, so they are similar by RHS.

spec.description: An upright isosceles triangle with equal-side ticks beside an inverted triangle.
spec.mathematics: Left supplied angles are 80° and 50° with equal sloping sides; right angles are 50°, 50° and 80°.
spec.answerVisibility: The unlabelled left base angle remains unlabelled.

answer.short: AAA: both triangles have angles $50^\circ$, $50^\circ$ and $80^\circ$.
answer.worked:
The equal sides in the left triangle give equal base angles, so its other base angle is $50^\circ$.
Both triangles have angles $50^\circ$, $50^\circ$ and $80^\circ$. At least two pairs of corresponding angles are equal, so the triangles are similar by AAA.

spec.description: Differently oriented triangles retaining the included 110° angles and four supplied side lengths.
spec.mathematics: Corresponding sides surrounding the included angle are 3 and 12, and 2.5 and 10.

answer.short: SAS: $\frac{12}{3}=\frac{10}{2.5}=4$ and the included angles are both $110^\circ$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}\frac{12}{3}&=4\\\frac{10}{2.5}&=4\end{aligned}$$
Two pairs of corresponding sides are in the same ratio and their included angles are both $110^\circ$, so the triangles are similar by SAS.

spec.description: An upright triangle beside an inverted triangle with all six side labels preserved.
spec.mathematics: Corresponding sides are 4 and 12, 5 and 15, and 6 and 18.
spec.answerVisibility: Correspondences and ratios are not supplied in the question figure.

answer.short: SSS: $\frac{12}{4}=\frac{15}{5}=\frac{18}{6}=3$, so all three pairs of corresponding sides are in the same ratio.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}\frac{12}{4}&=3\\\frac{15}{5}&=3\\\frac{18}{6}&=3\end{aligned}$$
Three pairs of corresponding sides are in the same ratio, so the triangles are similar by SSS.
